initiatives.name: Sage Copilot AI Assistant Platform
initiatives.summary: Sage has launched Sage Copilot, an AI-powered productivity assistant embedded across their product portfolio to automate tasks and deliver insights. The company is also developing specialist AI agents for specific business processes, operating behind the scenes within permissioned boundaries.

evidence.title: Sage Copilot AI Assistant Deployment
evidence.summary: Sage has launched Sage Copilot, an AI-powered productivity assistant embedded across their product portfolio to automate tasks and deliver insights. The company is also developing specialist AI agents for specific business processes, operating behind the scenes within permissioned boundaries.
evidence.quote: Importantly, we brought Sage Copilot, our generative AI-based digital assistant, to market in selected products and geographies, and thousands of customers are already using it to guide their decisions and streamline their work. Increasingly, our next-generation AI agents are automating tasks intelligently, but always with the customer in control.

evidence.title: Sage Platform Infrastructure Development
evidence.summary: Sage has developed the Sage Platform as foundational technology infrastructure enabling rapid deployment of AI innovations across multiple products. It provides unified interfaces, shared development tools, and built-in security guardrails to accelerate delivery while ensuring scalability and compliance.
evidence.quote: The Sage Platform is our foundational technology infrastructure, enabling rapid deployment of innovations such as Sage Copilot and AI agents across multiple products. It provides a unified interface for intelligent assistance within workflows, while AI helps automate complex, end-to-end processes.

initiatives.name: Share Buyback Programme
initiatives.summary: Sage completed a £600m share buyback program in FY25, purchasing 48.2m shares which were subsequently cancelled. The company announced an additional £300m share buyback program alongside FY25 results, reflecting strong cash generation and confidence in future prospects.

evidence.title: Share Buyback Program

evidence.quote: On 30 July 2025, Sage completed a share buyback programme, commenced on 20 November 2024 and extended on 15 May 2025, under which a total of 48.2m shares were purchased for an aggregate consideration of £600m and subsequently cancelled. evidence.title: London Office Relocation to Tower Bridge Court
evidence.summary: The Board approved relocating Sage's London office from the Shard to Tower Bridge Court in 2025. The new office will offer more collaborative space and will be 100% electric, net zero carbon in operation, targeting WELL Building Platinum certification.
evidence.quote: The Board noted that the proposed office space, once constructed, will be 100% electric and net zero carbon in operation, with no fossil fuels used in running the property, and is targeting a WELL Building Platinum certification.

initiatives.name: Sage Copilot AI Assistant
initiatives.summary: Sage launched Sage Copilot, a generative AI-powered digital assistant that streamlines routine tasks, provides strategic insights and enhances customer decision making. The AI assistant is available to over 8,000 customers across Sage Accounting, Sage for Accountants, and Sage Active, with Sage Intacct expected to follow in 2025.

evidence.title: Evolved Strategic Framework with Network Focus
evidence.summary: Sage evolved its strategic framework to focus on creating the world's most trusted network for SMBs, powered by Sage Copilot. The strategy centers on three pillars: connecting through Sage Network, growing by winning customers, and delivering AI-driven productivity.
evidence.quote: Our ambition is to create the world's most trusted, thriving network for SMBs, powered by Sage Copilot. Our strategy is to connect SMBs through our network, grow by winning new customers and delighting existing ones, and deliver productivity and insights driven by Artificial Intelligence (AI).

initiatives.name: Net Zero Carbon Reduction Programme
initiatives.summary: Sage has achieved significant progress against Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) validated interim targets with 89% reduction in Scope 1&2 emissions and 24% reduction in Scope 3 emissions. The company continues expanding carbon accounting capabilities to help SMBs measure and manage their emissions.

evidence.title: Net Zero Carbon Reduction Progress
evidence.summary: Sage has achieved significant progress against Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) validated interim targets with 89% reduction in Scope 1&2 emissions and 24% reduction in Scope 3 emissions. The company continues expanding carbon accounting capabilities to help SMBs measure and manage their emissions.
evidence.quote: We have progressed well against our interim targets, which were validated by SBTi in 2023; 89% reduction in absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions (Target: 50% by 2030); 24% reduction in absolute Scope 3 GHG emissions (Target: 50% by 2030)

initiatives.name: Science-Based Net Zero Targets
initiatives.summary: The Science Based Targets initiative validated Sage's net zero target for 2040, with interim targets including 50% reduction in Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions by 2030. Sage achieved a 75% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions and 13% reduction in Scope 3 emissions against targets.

evidence.title: Science-Based Net Zero Targets Validation
evidence.summary: The Science Based Targets initiative validated Sage's net zero target for 2040, with interim targets including 50% reduction in Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions by 2030. Sage achieved a 75% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions and 13% reduction in Scope 3 emissions against targets.
evidence.quote: The Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) validated Sage's net zero target. We continue to work towards our Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) validated carbon targets of halving emissions by 2030 and achieving net zero by 2040.
